To ensure the cylindrical geometry of the pole is consistent and that the signs attach logically without floating or clipping errors.
To check for clean boundaries between the signs and the sky/background, ensuring no edge bleeding or haloing.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output. In AI images, street signs often fail at the character level (e.g., 'Stevens' becoming 'Stevesns'). If the text is perfect, significantly boost the alignment score. Also, verify if the perspective of the signs matches the low-angle camera position.
